title: Explicit geometric map for return restriction
statement: Let k₀ and k₁ be finite fields with an algebra k₀→k₁, and let X/k₀ and C/k₁ be schemes. Given c:C→X commuting with their structural maps and a natural number r with #k₁=(#k₀)^r, there is a map v:Cbar→Xbar of geometric fibers [def-pc-base-change]. Its projection to X is Cbar→C→X, and its projection to Spec k₀bar is Cbar→Spec k₁bar followed by Spec of the inverse of the fixed k₀-algebra equivalence k₁bar≃k₀bar. It satisfies Fr_C;v=v;Fr_X^r. Both projection equations determine v by the pullback universal property. No immersion or finite-type hypothesis is required.

theorem exists_clopen_return_geometric_map
    {k₀ k₁ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] [Field k₁] [Finite k₁]
    [Algebra k₀ k₁] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k₀ k₁]
    {X C : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k₀))] [C.Over (Spec (.of k₁))]
    (c : C ⟶ X)
    (hc : c ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)) =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁)))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r) :
    ∃ v : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber,
      v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberProj =
        (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberProj ≫ c ∧
      v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure =
        (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraicClosureAlgEquiv k₀ k₁).symm.toRingHom) ∧
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom ≫ v =
        v ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ r).hom
